paper_title: Early-Universe Simulations of the Cosmological Axion
notes: Theoretical/numerical paper on early-universe simulations of the post-inflation PQ-breaking axion, computing the minihalo mass function and the DM density. Its headline result is a prediction of the QCD axion mass that yields the observed DM density, m_a = 25.2 +/- 11.0 microeV (equivalently f_a = (2.27 +/- 0.33)x10^11 GeV). It reports NO experimental or observational exclusion limit on any axion/dark-photon/scalar coupling. This is not a measured limit and not a coupling projection, so no data points are emitted. Figures 3 and 4 concern the minihalo mass distribution and Omega_a vs f_a, not a coupling exclusion.
